prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 50.3) about mathematics: The function is the abstract mathematical object that in some way exists whether or not anyone ever talks about it. But
true_answer: The function is the abstract mathematical object that in some way exists whether or not anyone ever talks about it. But when we do want to talk about the function, we need a way to describe it. A particular function can be described in multiple ways. Some calculus textbooks talk about the Rule of Four , that every function can be described in four ways: algebraically (a formula), numerically (a table), graphically, or in words.
